chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, all from Abu Hashim al-Ja'fari, who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far the Second (peace be upon him): 'What is the meaning of al-Wahid (the One)?' So he said: 'The consensus of the tongues upon Him with Oneness — like His saying, the Exalted:
"And if you were to ask them who created them, they would certainly say: Allah." [43:87]

key_terms.إِجْمَاعُ الْأَلْسُنِ: the consensus of the tongues — the unanimous acknowledgment by all people of God's oneness
key_terms.الْوَاحِدِ: al-Wahid — the Divine Name 'the One', signifying God's absolute and exclusive unity
key_terms.الْوَحْدَانِيَّةِ: wahdaniyya — absolute divine oneness; the exclusive unity belonging to God alone

ai.seo_question: What does the Divine Name al-Wahid (the One) mean according to Imam al-Jawad (peace be upon him) in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Abu Hashim al-Ja'fari reports asking Imam Muhammad al-Jawad (عليه السلام), the ninth Imam, about the meaning of the Divine Name 'al-Wahid' (the One). The Imam explained it as the unanimous testimony of all tongues to His Oneness, citing Quran 43:87 as proof that even those who associate partners with God instinctively acknowledge Him as sole Creator — making universal human recognition the very meaning of this Divine Name.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad and Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, altogether from Abu Hashim Al Ja’fary who said,

‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> the 2<sup>nd</sup>, ‘What is the meaning of ‘The One’?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The consensus of the tongues upon Him<sup>azwj</sup> with the Oneness like His<sup>azwj</sup> Words, the Exalted
[43:87] And if you should ask them who Created them, they would certainly say: Allah’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ali ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn al-Hassan has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa all of them from abu Hashim al-Ja‘fari who has said the following.
“I asked abu Ja‘far al-Thani, the 2nd (a.s.), “What is the meaning of the One?” The Imam replied, “It means the unanimity of all tongues in speaking of Allah’s Oneness.
If you ask them as to who has created them, they all say it is Allah, Who has created them.”
